title: e0vk(1): C root_dio_sig_verify_signature (sig_structure rebuild + sha256 + schnorr48_verify) + host tests
description: Parent: project-LICHEN-worker6-e0vk. Smallest landable piece: root_dio_sig.c gains root_dio_sig_verify_signature(sig, pubkey, sha256_fn) — rebuilds the COSE Sig_structure (0x84 0x6a 'Signature1' 0x47 a1013a00010000 0x40 0x58 <len> <payload>, canonical protected a1013a00010000), hashes via the injected sha256 fn (int (*)(const uint8_t*, size_t, uint8_t[32]) — tunnel_auth.c default_sha256 pattern), verifies via schnorr48_verify over the 32-byte digest. Byte-exact parity with python sha256(sig_structure) — the vector sig_structure field is the external oracle. Host test: extend lichen/tests/rpl_root_sig/ with the tinycrypt stub sha256 (coap_slot_claim pattern) + valid-vector verify OK, tampered/zero signature -> signature_invalid. RootSigError mapping: ROOT_SIG_ERR_SIGNATURE.
